role: Builds the browsable code-map report (index.html plus data/*.json) from the records, the current inventory and the source text: call graph, reachability, shared state, area and file flowcharts, findings. Invoked through `codemap.py report OUTDIR` / `make codemap-report`.
state: PROD: production area ids (excludes tests, build/CI/tools, docs, strings)
STATUS: maps a finding's `found` text to the report's status id (confirmed / new-in-verify; anything else 'later')
toplevel: Module docstring, imports (collections, html, json, re, shutil, Path, inventory.inventory) and the three constants. No side effects at import.

units.does: Loads docs/codemap/areas.json and returns a function mapping a path to its area: the listed area, else the most common area among listed files in the nearest enclosing directory, else 'N_nonswift'.
Area of one path, by exact entry or by majority vote of known files under each enclosing directory, walking upward.

branches.cond: some known file lies under this directory
branches.effect: most common area there; otherwise keep walking up, finally N_nonswift

units.does: Set of identifier tokens in a text.

Builds the report. Joins inventory and records into per-unit entries (branch offsets turned back into line numbers; `current` = record hash equals code hash) and collects every file and unit finding. Builds the call graph (graph.build) and merges it with the recorded calls (direct `path::key`, or keys embedded in dyn:/closure: text): recorded calls and certain graph edges become `callers`, possible graph edges not already certain become `possible_callers`, and both count as `targets` for reachability, so the unreachable list errs toward leaving code out. Reachability: walks the call graph from units with an external trigger, admitting a type once code already reached mentions it and seeding @main types plus EmuquMain/EmuquApp/WatchApp; dead types are those never admitted; then a name closure also marks a production unit reached when its type is live and its name appears in reached code; test code is walked separately. Groups reads/writes into shared-state rows with writer/reader areas. Counts area-to-area and file-to-file call edges and renders a whole-app Mermaid flowchart (edges of 8+ calls) and one per production area (45 strongest internal file links plus in/out traffic). Writes data/index.json, data/units/<area>.json, flags, stores, unreachable, strings, meta, and index.html from report_template.html, failing if any {{placeholder}} is left.

branches.effect: each listed with status from STATUS
converted to an absolute line; otherwise kept as written

branches.cond: graph edge is possible and not already a recorded or certain call
an @main attribute within 40 lines above a production unit
no further types referenced by reached code
unit already reached, not production Swift, or its type is not live
branches.effect: not considered by the name closure

branches.cond: name appears in reached code, or it is an init/deinit of a live type
singleton or external store touched by one unit only
branches.effect: left out of the shared-state table

branches.cond: area has calls to or from other areas
branches.effect: hub node with up to six in and six out links

branches.cond: a template placeholder was not filled

units.does: Unit keys a call entry resolves to: the entry itself when it is a unit key; for dyn:/closure: text, every embedded `path::` followed by the longest unit key of that file that matches at that position; otherwise none.

branches.cond: a unit key matches at this position

units.does: Source lines of a file, read once and cached.
Queues every not-yet-reached entry-point unit of a type.

Processes the queue: adds each unit's tokens (and its file's top-level tokens, once per file) to the referenced set, makes its type live (seeding that type's entry points), and queues its unreached production-Swift callees.

branches.cond: first unit reached in this file
branches.effect: the file's top-level tokens join the referenced set

units.does: Normalises a read/write entry like 'ud:key (note)' to 'ud:key': prefix without any parenthesised qualifier, key cut before an explanatory phrase or parenthesis, quotes and trailing period removed, at most 80 characters. Entries without a prefix give None.
